themes_detail.label: Industrial Waste Surge
themes_detail.summary: Industrial waste complaints spiked to 3 this week versus a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 2,300% increase (z-score: 8.69)—suggesting either a new illegal dumping operation, construction site violation, or environmental hazard in Upper West Side.
evidence: 3 industrial waste complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2,300% spike)
z-score of 8.69 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
No prior local news mentions, suggesting story is breaking now
reporting_angles: Locate the specific address(es) of the 3 complaints and investigate what industrial activity is occurring
Interview Department of Environmental Protection about enforcement actions and whether there are active violations in the district

themes_detail.label: Overgrown Tree/Branches Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Tree and branch overgrowth complaints reached 5 THIS WEEK compared to a 1.0 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 400% spike (z-score: 4.0)—potentially blocking sidewalks, creating safety hazards, or obstructing utilities across the neighborhood.
evidence: 5 overgrown tree/branch complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly baseline (400% increase)
Aligns with community board's long-standing park/amenity upgrade requests
reporting_angles: Document which parks or street corridors are most affected by overgrowth and assess whether it's a maintenance failure or seasonal issue
Interview Parks Department about staffing and maintenance schedules in CD 107

themes_detail.label: Curb Condition Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints jumped to 13 last week versus 3.0 weekly average—a 333% spike (z-score: 7.07)—indicating potential widespread street damage from potholing, construction, or weather that may affect accessibility and traffic safety.
evidence: 13 curb condition complaints last week vs. 3.0 weekly average (333% increase)
1,157 alteration permits filed in past 90 days suggest heavy construction activity that may be degrading street infrastructure
reporting_angles: Map the geographic distribution of the 13 curb complaints to identify a specific area of concern
Investigate whether recent construction permits or weather events (snow, freeze-thaw cycles) correlate with the spike

themes_detail.label: Asbestos Detection Spike
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints reached 6 last week compared to 1.0 weekly average—a 500% increase (z-score: 4.47)—potentially indicating aging building renovations, demolition work, or environmental contamination requiring immediate health agency investigation.
evidence: 6 asbestos complaints last week vs. 1.0 weekly baseline (500% increase)
z-score of 4.47 indicates statistically significant spike
1,074 alteration permits filed in past 90 days; 7 demolitions suggest renovation/demolition activity that often disturbs asbestos
reporting_angles: Cross-reference the 6 asbestos complaints with DOB permits to determine if renovations/demolitions are the source
Interview Department of Environmental Protection and NYC Health about whether complaints indicate unsafe abatement practices or building violations

themes_detail.label: Street Light Outages Persist
themes_detail.summary: Street light condition complaints were 27 two weeks ago versus 11.0 weekly average—a 146% spike (z-score: 5.57)—leaving portions of the Upper West Side without nighttime illumination and raising public safety concerns, though this signal is aging slightly.
evidence: 27 street light complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 11.0 weekly average (146% spike)
No follow-up data from this week suggests potential remediation, but pattern should be monitored
reporting_angles: Check whether the spike has been resolved or if outages persist; obtain current street light status from Department of Transportation
Identify which blocks experienced outages and interview residents about safety impacts during the 2-week period
